## Purpose

Implements the Results/Steps/Files/Audit surfaces mounted inside `PreviewPanel`: the per-agent
execution trace (Steps), the deliverable/agent-output download list (Files), and the
governance/validation trail (Audit). Depended on by `preview` (which mounts `FilesTab`/
`AgentThinkingTab`/`AuditTab` as its other tabs) and by `history`/`chat`/`layout`, which reuse the same
tab components for reopened and in-flight runs.

## Shape

- [AgentThinkingTab.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/AgentThinkingTab.tsx) — the Steps tab root; owns the three-level drill-down
  (`selectedAgentId`/`selectedTaskIndex` state) between `StepsOverviewSpine` (L1), `AgentDetailPanel`
  (L2), and `TaskDetailPanel` (L3). Fetches gate events itself (`getRunGateEvents`) to interleave
  "Review gate … approved" strips into the spine.
- [StepsOverviewSpine.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/StepsOverviewSpine.tsx) — L1: a status line + segmented progress bar derived from live
  `pipelineState`/`agents`, the reused `ClarificationsCard`, an inline "Awaiting you" gate/clarify card
  (`InlineGateActions`/`InlineClarifyActions` borrowed from `components/chat`), and a compact per-agent
  row list that opens L2.
- [AgentDetailPanel.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/AgentDetailPanel.tsx) (~925 lines) — L2: a two-column agent detail (reasoning/artifact/tool-calls/
  input/output on the left, a sticky "Context received" panel on the right built from
  `agent.contextSources`). Renders a per-agent artifact card (spec/tasks/analysis) via the shared
  `discriminateArtifact` from [artifactPreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/artifactPreview.tsx), and nests the agent's build-task tree
  (waves/subagents) inline rather than in a separate component.
- [TaskDetailPanel.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/TaskDetailPanel.tsx) — L3: a single construction task's status/reasoning, opened from an L2 task
  row.
- [artifactPreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/artifactPreview.tsx) — the shared, name-free artifact-kind discriminator (`discriminateArtifact`)
  plus `parseSpecSections`/`parseSpecOverview`/`parseTasks`; extracted so both the settled artifact
  cards and the (separate) gate plan-preview parse artifacts identically.
- [ArtifactVersionPicker.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/ArtifactVersionPicker.tsx) — a per-artifact version dropdown for L2, distinct from `PreviewPanel`'s
  run-family version menu — it walks `artifact_refs` (deduped by `content_hash`) rather than the run
  family's `parent_run_id` chain.
- [FilesTab.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/FilesTab.tsx) (~1034 lines) — the Files tab: per-agent output rows, a generic-deliverable row
  (dispatched on mimetype), a "Run input" section (`prompt.md`/`clarifications.md`), and a
  lazily-fetched "From v{n-1}" base-version section for revisions. Exports
  `downloadBlob`/`deriveDeliverableFilename`, reused by `PreviewPanel`'s header download button.
- [AuditTab.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/AuditTab.tsx) (~959 lines) — reads three owner-scoped endpoints (gate-events/validation-results/
  exec-runs) into one unified `AuditRow` model, with severity filters and client-side CSV/JSON export.
- [ClarificationsCard.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/ClarificationsCard.tsx), [ValidatorIssuePanel.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/ValidatorIssuePanel.tsx), [StartingPointCard.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/StartingPointCard.tsx) — smaller presentational
  cards: collapsed-by-default clarification Q&A, live validator-issue list grouped by severity, and the
  run's starting input (brief/revision-instruction/chain-context), respectively.
- Imports `components/chat` (gate/clarify inline actions, `RunLaneState`), `components/workflow`
  (`TokenUsageSummary`), `components/preview` (`ReadOnlyVersionBanner`, and
  `PreviewPanel.DegradedRunAffordance` is itself exported for reuse by `history`), and `hooks`/`lib`
  for stats formatting and the API client.

## Why this shape

**The Steps tab's three levels (spine → agent detail → task detail) are separate components
specifically so each nesting level can be navigated to and tested independently**, replacing an
earlier flat `AgentTimelineCard` list plus a separate `WaveTreePanel` — the codebase's inline comments
call this out as "single implementation, no dual view" (INV-3/INV-12).

Artifact-kind detection (`discriminateArtifact`) is centralized in [artifactPreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/results/artifactPreview.tsx) and keyed only
on the artifact's own declared kind or wrapper tag (`<spec>`/`<tasks>`/`<analysis>`), never an agent id
or workflow name, so the same card renderer works for any agent that happens to emit a recognized
artifact shape.

`ArtifactVersionPicker` is kept deliberately separate from the run-family version control in
[preview/RunHeader.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/RunHeader.tsx) because they walk different data axes (per-artifact `artifact_refs.version` vs.
per-run `parent_run_id` family chain) and **conflating them was an explicitly rejected design**.

`AuditTab` and `FilesTab` are two of the largest files in the module because each owns a full
data-fetch-plus-render pipeline (three endpoints unified into one row model; per-agent + generic +
run-input + base-version file rows) rather than delegating to shared list primitives, trading some size
for keeping all of a tab's business logic in one file.
